verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Gemini models are reachable via OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/google/gemini-3-pro-preview), satisfying the 'OpenRouter-class router' part of the story, but there is no evidence in the pack of Gemini being offered through AWS Bedrock, Azure, or even Google's own Vertex AI as an alternative to the direct Gemini API endpoint. Missing for 10: Bedrock availability, Azure availability, Vertex AI multi-cloud packaging, and any first-party confirmation of these integrations beyond a single community mention with noted latency/reliability caveats.
